name: Dandelion
source:
What seems to be just another normal day and a comfortable life of a young prince changed with an explosion on their castle.

"Why!..Why would you do this!?"

"...He does not need to know anything.."

As he rushed to the scene, what he found was something that he will never forget.

What greeted him was a sight that he will never forget. Countless bodies of soldiers and retainers- all lifeless.

He searched through the place and there he found...

His parents- the King and Queen of the Zurwiltz Kingdom has been killed!

Who could've possibly done it to the strongest kingdom in the continent?

Among the corpses, there stand a figure...of someone he knows. It was of his dear brother's. He couldn't believe it but the evidence is there-Someone with the power to accomplish such feat, someone who knows how to fight against the continent's finest soldiers. But the most incriminating of it all, the evidence no one can ever deny...

Is the blood dripping from the tip of his dear brother's spear. 

Despite all of it, the young prince- maybe out of fear, maybe out of love? Cannot find it in himself to feel any hatred for his dear brother whom he looks up to for committing such an act.

"Why? Despite everything does he still believe in him?" 

Was it faith? That blinds him from the facts staring him at the face? Or is it their fate? A piece of the larger picture from a plan that has the whole world set as its stage.

[From [url=https://neinsworks.itch.io/dandelion-chapter-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对一位年轻王子而言原本再寻常不过的一天与安逸的生活，随着城堡里的一场爆炸而彻底改变。

“为什么！……你为什么要这么做！？”

“……他什么都不需要知道……”

当他赶到现场时，眼前的景象令他终生难忘。

映入他眼帘的是永生难忘的一幕：无数士兵与家臣的尸骸横陈在地，全都失去了生机。

他在现场四处搜寻，结果发现……

他的双亲——苏尔维尔茨王国的国王与王后，竟然已经遇害！

究竟是谁，能对这片大陆上最强大的王国犯下如此恶行？

在尸骸之间，伫立着一道身影……一个他认识的人。那是他挚爱的兄长。他不敢相信自己的眼睛，可铁证如山——有能力做到这一切的人，清楚如何与大陆最精锐的士兵交战的人。然而最致命、最无可辩驳的铁证……

正是从他挚爱兄长的枪尖滴落的鲜血。

即便如此，这位年轻的王子——或许是出于恐惧，又或许是出于爱意？面对自己一向敬仰的兄长犯下的暴行，他心中却无论如何也生不出一丝仇恨。

“为什么？尽管发生了这一切，他却依然相信着他？”

是因为信任蒙蔽了他的双眼，让他对摆在面前的事实视而不见吗？还是说这就是他们的宿命——那场以整个世界为舞台的宏大计划中的一环？
